newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DAOU Systems started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DAOU Systems started.

text.p: Robertson Stephens said it initiated coverage of DAOU Systems Inc with a buy rating.
-- said DAOU is a leader in focused network infrastructure consulting services exclusively for the health care industry.
-- said "DAOU is uniquely positioned in this rapidly growing market for health care computer network services."

-- said DAOU should grow revenue 60 percent over the next two to three years "as it reaps the benefits of heavy infrastructure investments in sales and marketing, regional offices, and senior management talent."
-- expects DAOU to earn $0.03 a share in 1997 and $0.43 a share in 1998.
